description: Perform deterministic offline geometric calculations on bounding boxes, points, polygons, and 3D camera frustums (zero network calls): 'relation' (intersects, contains, overlap area %, union & intersection bbox between two geometries), 'point_in_geometry' (check if a point is inside a bbox or WKT/GeoJSON polygon respecting interior holes), 'distance_bearing' (WGS84 ellipsoidal Vincenty distance, initial/final bearings, geodesic midpoint, and ENU vector between two points), 'split_grid' (subdivide a bbox into an N x M grid), or 'camera_footprint' (3D ray-ellipsoid intersection to project a drone/aerial camera frustum onto the WGS84 ground polygon).

altitude_meters.description: Camera altitude in meters above WGS84 ellipsoid for 'camera_footprint' (> 0, <= 100000).

aspect_ratio.description: Image width/height aspect ratio for 'camera_footprint' (0.2 to 5, default 16/9).

bbox_a.description: First geometry / bounding box (for 'relation', 'point_in_geometry', 'split_grid'), origin point 'lat,lng' (for 'distance_bearing'), or camera position 'lat,lng' (for 'camera_footprint').

bbox_b.description: Second geometry / bounding box (for 'relation') or destination point 'lat,lng' (for 'distance_bearing').

cols.description: Number of longitude columns for 'split_grid' (1-20, default 2).

fov_degrees.description: Horizontal camera field of view in degrees for 'camera_footprint' (5 to 150, default 60).

heading_degrees.description: Camera azimuth/heading in degrees clockwise from North for 'camera_footprint' (default 0).

max_ray_distance_meters.description: Maximum slant ray clamp distance in meters when frustum corners approach the horizon (defaults to max(50000, altitude_meters * 10)).

pitch_degrees.description: Camera pitch angle in degrees for 'camera_footprint': -90 is straight down (nadir, default), -2 is near horizontal.

roll_degrees.description: Camera roll angle in degrees around look axis for 'camera_footprint' (default 0).

rows.description: Number of latitude rows for 'split_grid' (1-20, default 2).

name: spatial_calc
